objective: Improve browser PTT button behavior on mobile and desktop: immediate and safe hold-to-talk, pointer-captured release, clearly disabled unconnected state, accurate connection statuses, and guarded SOS mode.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: canonical main SHA 01f6c3a6a274a745c06c6e8adf4d89097f10000a includes published browser PTT and reconciled production CORS Edge Function source. Supabase PTT access v13 and captions v3 ACTIVE, both with x-buklod-client headers; RLS and server floor RPCs inspected 2026-11-11. Live browser microphone behavior remains unverified until authenticated hardware testing; Web release must pass original exact RC/Expo Hosting gates.
chosenApproach: Change only the platform-specific web PTT screen and its focused tests. Replace Pressable hold-to-talk with a real browser button using primary-pointer capture and explicit up/cancel/lost-capture, keyboard release, global blur/page hide fallback, and touch-action prevention. Retain existing authenticated Stream call and floor lease runtime, plus Android implementation.
selectionRationale: The scrollable web route originally depended on Pressable onPressIn/onPressOut, which may be delayed or canceled by touch scrolling; pointer capture releases reliably when finger leaves target, and release errors cannot leave a hold active. Single-flight connect prevents duplicate Edge calls. The existing runtime handles lease cancellation.
alternativeApproaches: Replace entire PTT transport with new WebRTC state manager; rejected as duplicate backend authorization and Android regression risk.
Use tap-to-toggle audio; rejected due accidental hot microphone and violation of PTT release-on-lift semantics.
Selected: web-only native browser pointer capture plus existing floor and Stream runtime.
acceptanceChecks: Connected Hold to Talk starts only for primary left pointer and releases on pointer-up, pointer-cancel, lost capture, blur, pagehide, touchend and keyboard keyup.
Disconnected talk control is genuinely disabled and displays CONNECT FIRST; no microphone request from pressing it.
Connected, disconnected, joining, leaving, switching, requesting floor and transmitting status reflect the actual runtime, and duplicate connect requests are suppressed.
Keyboard Space/Enter press/release works without stuck microphone, and mobile touch is not hijacked into page scroll.
Priority/SOS permissions stay server-governed, SOS selection requires explicit browser confirmation.
Browser network/authorization/microphone errors are legible with clear retry guidance; no automatic repeated retries or redundant backend calls.
Updated PTT contract tests and TypeScript/web export/production deployment gates pass, no Android OTA triggered.
preserveBehaviors: Browser-to-Android shared CH01–CH10 call identity, membership and server floor validation.
Android native PTT and background features remain unchanged, as do existing browser chat and caption consent.
All other BUKLOD web routes, calls, ads and sound behavior remain untouched.
Web-only release uses existing reviewed production marker, exact SHA and EAS hosting verification.
